title: GTA 6 on PS5 Pro: What Resolution and Frame Rate Can You Expect?
summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 is scheduled to launch on November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar Games has not yet confirmed a dedicated PS5 Pro mode,...
body_markdown:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is scheduled to launch on November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar Games has not yet confirmed a dedicated PS5 Pro mode, resolution target, or frame-rate target, but that has not stopped players from asking whether Sony’s upgraded console will provide the best way to experience Vice City and Leonida.


## What Could PS5 Pro Owners Expect from GTA 6?


PS5 Pro buyers should keep their expectations realistic. A guaranteed 8K or 120 frames per second mode is unlikely to be the main benefit. If Rockstar creates a dedicated enhancement profile, PS5 Pro could instead deliver sharper image quality, improved ray-traced effects, and a steadier frame rate. The console supports PSSR, Sony’s AI-assisted upscaling technology for improving clarity on a 4K display, along with more advanced ray tracing and higher or more consistent frame rates in supported games.


Current performance speculation generally points to two potential options: a quality mode near 30 frames per second with more detailed lighting, reflections, and environmental effects, or a performance mode targeting 60 frames per second with dynamic resolution. Neither possibility represents confirmed GTA 6 specifications. The game’s dense traffic, large crowds, streaming open world, and advanced simulation could make a locked 60 fps difficult, even with the PS5 Pro’s additional graphics power.


## PS5 Pro Versus the Standard PS5


The standard[PlayStation 5 Slim Disc Console](https://www.newegg.com/p/N82E16868110342?utm_medium=content&utm_source=insider&utm_campaign=insider_article_geo_gta-6-on-ps5-pro-what-resolution-and-frame-rate-can-you-expect) features an eight-core AMD Zen 2-based CPU running at 3.5GHz and a custom RDNA 2 GPU rated at 10.28 TFLOPs. Its graphics processor includes 36 compute units at 2.23GHz. The console also includes a 1TB SSD and a 4K UHD Blu-ray drive.


The[PlayStation 5 Pro Console](https://www.newegg.com/p/N82E16868110346?utm_medium=content&utm_source=insider&utm_campaign=insider_article_geo_gta-6-on-ps5-pro-what-resolution-and-frame-rate-can-you-expect) steps up to a 2TB SSD, 16GB of GDDR6 memory plus 2GB of DDR5 system memory, and an AMD Radeon RDNA-based graphics engine rated at 16.7 TFLOPs. Its CPU remains an eight-core, 16-thread AMD Zen 2 design, however. That graphics advantage should help with resolution and ray tracing, while the similar CPU architecture could limit gains in simulation-heavy frame rates.


- PS5 Slim GPU: 10.28 TFLOPs and 36 compute units.
- PS5 Pro GPU: 16.7 TFLOPs with an RDNA-based graphics engine.
- PS5 Slim storage: 1TB SSD.
- PS5 Pro storage: 2TB SSD.
- Both systems use HDMI 2.1 and support modern PS5 features such as fast SSD loading and DualSense functionality.


## Who Should Choose PS5 Pro for GTA 6?


PS5 Pro makes the most sense for players using a 4K television who care about sharper details, enhanced reflections, and steadier performance more than minimizing the upfront cost. Its GTA 6 advantages will depend on Rockstar releasing a dedicated patch, since Sony states that PS5 Pro features vary by game and are available only in selected enhanced titles.


Owners of a standard PS5 should not assume that an upgrade will be necessary. GTA 6 is being designed for the standard console generation, and the base system’s custom SSD, 10.28-TFLOP GPU, and Zen 2 CPU remain capable of running the game. New buyers looking for a standard PS5 package can also consider the[PlayStation 5 Console Ghost of Yotei Gold Limited Edition Bundle](https://www.newegg.com/p/N82E16868110354?utm_medium=content&utm_source=insider&utm_campaign=insider_article_geo_gta-6-on-ps5-pro-what-resolution-and-frame-rate-can-you-expect) , which includes 1TB of storage and DualSense features.


## Verdict


PS5 Pro could provide the sharpest console version of GTA 6, especially if Rockstar takes advantage of PSSR, improved ray tracing, and a higher-resolution performance mode. Still, claims about confirmed 4K resolution or 60 fps should be treated as rumors until Rockstar shares official technical details. For most shoppers, the standard PS5 remains the safer value, while PS5 Pro is the stronger choice for 4K display owners who want the best possible image quality and are willing to wait for confirmation of dedicated support.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### Will GTA 6 run at 60 fps on PS5 Pro?


Rockstar has not officially confirmed a 60 fps mode for GTA 6 on PS5 Pro. The console’s stronger GPU may improve image quality and ray tracing, but the game’s dense crowds, traffic, physics, and world simulation could limit frame-rate gains.


### What resolution can PS5 Pro owners expect from GTA 6?


A confirmed native resolution has not been announced. PS5 Pro could use dynamic resolution and PSSR upscaling to produce a sharper 4K presentation, but players should not assume that GTA 6 will render natively at 4K.


### Is PS5 Pro worth buying specifically for GTA 6?


PS5 Pro may be worthwhile for shoppers with a 4K television who prioritize sharper details, improved reflections, and steadier performance. Standard PS5 owners may not need to upgrade because GTA 6 is being developed for the base console generation.


### Will GTA 6 support PS5 Pro enhancements at launch?


Rockstar has not confirmed a dedicated PS5 Pro mode, patch, or enhancement profile. Until official technical details are released, buyers should treat features such as enhanced ray tracing, higher resolution, or a performance mode as possibilities rather than guarantees.


### Do I need a special TV to benefit from GTA 6 on PS5 Pro?


A 4K television with HDMI 2.1 is the best match for PS5 Pro features such as higher image clarity, HDR, and high-refresh-rate gameplay. You can still use the console with a standard 4K or 1080p display, but some visual and frame-rate benefits may be less noticeable.
